summary.zh: inventory 与 dedupe 判断 MCP 目标：指纹相同但目标不同或无法确认的条目不再算重复，改列入 mcp_hints；每条 MCP 新增 target 与 target_class。
summary.en: inventory and dedupe now judge the MCP target: entries with the same fingerprint but a different or unconfirmed target are no longer duplicates and are listed in mcp_hints; every MCP entry gains target and target_class.
